## File: `AGENTS.md`

# AGENTS.md

Canonical instructions for every coding agent working in `pauli-contextuality-lab` (Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Grok Build, Grok Bot, and others).
`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc`, and `llms.txt` only point here. Edit this file, never the pointers.
Full standard: `docs/build-standard.md` (Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0, 90 items).

## Project

- **Name:** Pauli Contextuality Lab (`pauli-contextuality-lab`)
- **Purpose:** Unified Lean 4.35.0 (Mathlib v4.35.0) and exact-arithmetic verification repository for three Pauli contextuality research tracks:
  1. `tracks/spectral-bounds/` (`lean/HoggarBound/`): Spectral floor (Hoggar/Kramers bound), floor-saturating states including the infinite pure-CCZ determinant family `|Psi_{3m}>`, classical N=4..5 ladders, exact four-qubit C3 binary optima (`368` vs `344`), and Jonah's Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases for every `N >= 4`.
  2. `tracks/disjoint-mermin/` (`lean/ContextualityTensor/`): Exact contextuality degrees `d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2` (`k` disjoint Peres-Mermin squares) and `(6^k - 4^k)/2` (`k` Mermin pentagrams), answering Section 6 of Muller & Saniga (`arXiv:2609.19862v1`).
  3. `tracks/sequential-evidence/` (`lean/Evidence/`): Exact finite-tree sequential contextuality evidence bounds and constructive setting-bias attack on the Peres-Mermin square (`97.24%` naive vs `0.89%` corrected false rejection at nominal `1%`).
- **Author:** Alexander S. Donahue (independent researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`)
- **Licenses:** `Apache-2.0` (`LICENSE`, all code) + `CC-BY-4.0` (`LICENSE-DOCS`, all papers/docs/figures) + MIT for vendored `third_party/` (`NOTICE`)
- **Manifest:** `repo.yaml` (schema: `repo-standard.schema.json`), `formalization.yaml` (Palomar-compatible Lean provenance)
- **Status:** Active research preprints — NOT externally peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction.

## Layout

- `lean/`: Single unified Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 package (`HoggarBound`, `ContextualityTensor`, `Evidence`, `Challenge`, `Solution`, `VerifyAll`, `comparator.json`).
- `tracks/`: Track-specific C11 engines, Python exact verifiers, interactive browser labs (`web/`), and checked JSON receipts (`results/`).
- `papers/`: Publication manuscripts (`spectral-bounds/`, `disjoint-mermin/`, `sequential-evidence/`), PDFs, LaTeX sources, BibTeX, and correspondence guide.
- `data/`: Witness hex masks, flat-state supports, and `data/MANIFEST.sha256`.
- `third_party/`: Single deduplicated vendored Tsotchke stack (`moonlab/`, `qgtl/`, `quantum_rng/`, `SHA256SUMS.json`).
- `blueprint/`: Lean Blueprint LaTeX (`blueprint/src/content.tex`) + declaration-checked dependency graph builder.
- `scripts/`: Unified verification (`verify_all.py`), Blueprint builder (`build_blueprint.py`), static site builder (`build_site.py`), citation/axiom/arithmetic audits, and Build Standard v1.2.0 auditors (`audit-repo.sh`, `Audit-Repo.ps1`).
- `tests/`: Automated Python (exact, Hypothesis property, negative, mutation/fuzz, integrity) and Node.js test suites.
- `docs/`: Architecture, ADRs, statement-fidelity table, threat model, operations, FAQ, glossary, run log, and 10-pass review logs.

## Commands

Run via `just <recipe>` or `bash scripts/dev.sh <recipe>`:

- `just setup`: Install pinned Python dependencies (`requirements.txt`) and fetch pinned Mathlib cache (`lean/`).
- `just build`: Build all three Lean libraries (`HoggarBound`, `ContextualityTensor`, `Evidence`) and compile C11 verifiers with `-Wall -Wextra`.
- `just test`: Run the unified Python (`pytest`) and Node (`node --test`) verification suites across all 3 tracks.
- `just lint`: Run `ruff`, `mypy`, C compiler warnings, and Batteries `lake exe runLinter` (report-only).
- `just sanitizers`: Compile and execute C11 engines under `-fsanitize=address,undefined`.
- `just verify-lean`: Build Lean modules, run exhaustive `#print axioms` audit (`VerifyAll.lean`), check zero forbidden tokens, and run 6-kernel `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`.
- `just blueprint`: Validate every `\lean{...}` declaration in `blueprint/src/content.tex` and build the dependency graph.
- `just site`: Assemble the unified GitHub Pages portal (`build/site/`) including all 3 browser labs, papers, and `/blueprint/`.
- `just reproduce`: Clean-clone end-to-end exact verification + audits + blueprint + site assembly.
- `just audit`: Score this repository against Build Standard v1.2.0 (`scripts/audit-repo.sh` / `scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1`).
- `just release X.Y.Z`: Bump `VERSION`, update `CHANGELOG.md`/`CITATION.cff`, tag `vX.Y.Z`, and push straight to `main`.

## Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0)

- **R1.** Nothing may gate, block, or slow a commit or push. No branch protection, no required status checks, no commit/tag signing requirements, no git hooks, no push protection, no merge queues, no coverage/lint/SAST/SBOM gates.
- **R2.** Commit and push straight to `main`. No pull requests and no feature branches.
- **R3.** CI is informational. Failures are findings fixed in follow-up commits to `main`.
- **R4.** Banned tools/files: no Dependabot/Renovate, no PR templates, no CodeRabbit, no Copilot review or `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, no `FUNDING.yml`.
- **R5.** One-person lean, not corporate. Prefer one file over a framework, one command over a checklist.
- **R6.** Never fabricate. Every number, claim, axiom output, badge, and test result must come from a real run of current code.
- **R7.** Classify every finding as exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot` (definitions in `docs/glossary.md`).
- **R8.** Precedence: Owner's explicit instruction > Hard Rules > Build Standard items > ecosystem conventions.

## Known Traps

- **`lean/Challenge.lean` intentional `sorry` stubs:** `Challenge.lean` contains `sorry` ONLY as the isolated statement-only specification checked against sorry-free `Solution.lean` by `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`. Never put `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, or custom `axiom` in any proof module or `Solution.lean`.
- **Single GitHub Pages site:** `.github/workflows/pages.yml` deploys `build/site/` assembled by `scripts/build_site.py`, mounting `/blueprint/` alongside all three interactive browser labs and papers. Never add a second Pages workflow.
- **PowerShell bracket safety on Windows:** On the author's ReFS Dev Drive (`Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\...`), always use `-LiteralPath` in PowerShell file cmdlets.
- **Honest affiliation & scope:** Always use `Alexander S. Donahue (independent researcher)` (never assert an unformed LLC). Never claim external peer review, journal acceptance, arXiv submission, or Palomar registration unless genuinely completed.

## File: `CLAIMS.md`

# Claims & Falsification Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every headline claim in `pauli-contextuality-lab` is tagged with its exact verification status (`kernel-checked`, `certificate-checked`, `paper proof`, `numerical_approximation`, or `open`), its relation to earlier work, and an explicit falsification condition (Build Standard items B04 & B42).

**Kernel coverage.** `kernel-checked` means checked by the Lean 4.35.0 kernel (`lake build`, `#print axioms` in `lean/VerifyAll.lean`, `lean/VerifyStandalone.lean`, and `lean/VerifyPhaseSeven.lean`, standard axioms only). The **24 comparator targets** in `lean/comparator.json` (Targets 1–24 below, including Track 2 actual-context degrees, heterogeneous endpoint reduction, mixed square/pentagram degrees, general-seed universal limit, arbitrary-$k$ $2k$- and $3k$-qubit Pauli realizations, $k$-independent readout-noise thresholds, and kernel-proved false-variant refutations) and their dependency closure are also accepted by 6 independent kernels via `lake comparator --paranoid`. As of `v3.2.0`–`v3.3.0`, the nine standalone Track 1 finite-certificate modules (`Saturated*`, `C3Certificate`, `C3Spectra`, `C3Theorem`, `FlatData`, `PhaseData`) are compiled and axiom-audited in dedicated parallel CI jobs (`lean-verify-standalone` and `lean-verify-phase7`).

**Statement audit.** The wording below was corrected on 2026-11-26 to match an independent statement audit ([audit log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)); see [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md).

| **C12** | Track 3 | Peres-Mermin setting-bias failure floor $\min_c p(c)$, finite betting-tree hitting bound $\le z/T$, and miscalibrated 1% test false-rejection probability $97.2443815\%$ vs $0.8907211\%$ at horizon 1,000 | `kernel-checked` (bounds & 36-step counterexample, $> 4.3\%$) + `certificate-checked` (exact rational 1,000-step DP & 18,000-trial replay) | Formalization of elementary known bounds (finite form of Ville's inequality; `papers/sequential-evidence/PRIOR_ART.md`) | `lean/Evidence/{Square,Sequential}.lean`, `tracks/sequential-evidence/scripts/verify_artifact.py`, `tests/test_sequential_evidence.py`, Targets 11–12 | A valid finite tree exceeding $z/T$ hitting probability, or a rational DP discrepancy against exhaustive path enumeration. |
| **C13** | All | Browser labs and Moonlab / QGTL / `quantum_rng` runs | `numerical_approximation` (classical simulation) | Not a research claim | `third_party/`, `results/arithmetic-audit.json` | Not a hardware quantum claim; falsified if simulator disagrees with exact analytical Pauli expectations beyond stated tolerance. |

## File: `LIMITATIONS.md`

# Limitations, Epistemic Boundaries, and AI-Contribution Disclosure

## 1. Real vs. Metaphor & What Is Not Claimed

- **Not externally peer reviewed:** All three manuscripts in `papers/` are unreviewed research preprints. Passing Lean 4 kernel checks certifies the logical validity of the formalized statements inside Lean — not external referee acceptance, historical priority, or statement-to-literature fidelity.
- **No quantum hardware measurements:** Moonlab (`third_party/moonlab/`) is a classical state-vector simulator compiled to WebAssembly; `quantum_rng` (`third_party/quantum_rng/`) is a seeded classical pseudorandom generator; QGTL (`third_party/qgtl/`) provides classical differential-geometry C kernels. Nothing in this repository is a physical experiment on quantum hardware or certified quantum randomness.
- **Prior work & unreviewed preprint citations:**
  - The spectral floor inequality, its Kramers variant and Conjecture E stem from unreviewed Zenodo preprints by B. W. Jonah (`doi:10.5281/zenodo.23538829`, `23510634`, `23524332`). The floors are Jonah's prior results; this repository formalizes them for arbitrary supports. Jonah's preprint `23538829` also states an attainment criterion for closed families that overlaps `saturation_tfae`. Jonah's computer-assisted note `23510634` (20 October 2026) already claimed the exact values $d(W(7,2)) = 1575$ and $d(Q^+(9,2)) = 6975$, which imply the kernel-checked lower bounds $1455$ and $6444$ proved here. The Conjecture E source is AI-assisted and AI-refereed; it already proves cases C1 and C6.
  - Symplectic polar-space degrees: Muller et al. (`arXiv:2407.02928`). The repeated-disjoint-copy question: A. Muller and M. Saniga (`arXiv:2609.19862v1`, an unreviewed arXiv v1 preprint). Their Sec. 4.2 gives the context-count product formula $|HS(G_1 \cup \dots \cup G_k)| = \prod_i (|HS(G_i)|+1) - 1$ used in Track 2. A. Cabello (`arXiv:1002.3135`, 2010) reports a related growth result, in which the violation grows exponentially with $n$.
  - $d(Q^+(7,2))=315$ is due to Li, Gupta, and Ganesh (`arXiv:2610.26465`); the numerical five-qubit flat state is due to Cieśliński (`arXiv:2610.07172`); the scalar skewness bound is Okumura (1974).
  - Concurrent independent work: a Zenodo deposit (`doi:10.5281/zenodo.24567331`, created 26 November 2026, after the v3.0.0 CI run) describes a floor-type lower bound, the $1/2$ limit, an exactness criterion for pure states with constant-modulus Pauli expectations, a five-qubit configuration of degree 480, and a Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization. It is later than, not prior to, this release; the overlap has not been compared in detail.
  - Novelty claims (Track 1 Section 5 flat states and $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$, Track 1 Conjecture E formalization, Track 2 arbitrary-$k$ closed forms) rest on bounded literature searches and do not claim exhaustive historical priority. The question answered by $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$ was posed in this repository's own manuscript, not by another author.
- **Scope of the answers to external questions:**
  - Track 2 answers the stacking-limit question at the end of the second paragraph of Muller & Saniga, Sec. 6, for disjoint Peres–Mermin squares, Mermin pentagrams, mixed square/pentagram unions (`mixed_square_pentagram_minimum`), and arbitrary finite contextual signed seeds (`general_seed_epsilon_tends_to_one`, Theorem 5), all formalized in Lean 4.35.0. Explicit single-seed Pauli coordinates for two doily copies or other non-square/pentagram geometries named in the same sentence are not constructed here (though Theorem 5 applies once any finite contextual signed seed is given). The source poses this as an open question in its discussion, not as a conjecture.
  - Track 1 proves strict-law failure for one explicit representative of each of the nine vertex cases of Conjecture E, for every $N \ge 4$. Case membership of each representative and transfer to whole cases (Jonah's Theorem B4) are outside Lean (Section 2).

## 2. Explicit Kernel Boundary (What Lies Outside Lean 4)

The following items are **not** certified by the Lean 4 kernel and are explicitly tagged as `certificate-checked`, `paper proof`, or `numerical_approximation` in `CLAIMS.md`:

1. **42-orbit `W(5,2)` census (`tracks/spectral-bounds/src/w52_census_verify.c`):** Exhaustive C11 enumeration (17,652,160 classes across 42 orbits) + pure-integer Python duals reproducing Jonah's $(315, 1575, 6975)$. Lean proves the exact master reduction (`exact_degrees_n4_n5_of_q7minus_315`) and the lower bounds `1455` and `6444` (which do not depend on the census), not the C orbit search itself. The exact values 1575 and 6975 hold in Lean only conditionally on $d(Q^-(7,2)) \ge 315$.
2. **Nine-qubit cyclic-symmetry rank-8 search (`n9_rank8_search.c`):** C11 enumeration of 540,299,769 forms (0 hits).
3. **Single-orbit transitivity input (`Jonah [J3, Theorem B4]`):** Cited paper input for transporting Conjecture E from our one formally certified representative per vertex case (`HoggarBound/ConjectureECases.lean`, `IsCaseC1`–`IsCaseC15`) to arbitrary hyperplane classes inside that case.
4. **Floating-point scripts:** Every Python file using `numpy` or floating-point arithmetic is automatically classified in `results/arithmetic-audit.json` (`scripts/arithmetic_audit.py`) and never relied upon for a formal proof.
5. **Physical assumptions of Track 3 (`Evidence`):** The finite adaptive-tree theorem assumes a true conditional setting floor $\beta$ and single context-independent value table per trial; no empirical transcript alone can certify those physical assumptions.
6. **Track 2 formal coverage (100% of Eqs. 1–16 closed in `v3.3.0`):** `ContextualityTensor/SeedSupport.lean` proves literal 3-qubit Mermin pentagram Pauli matrices (`pentagramMatrix`), the 6-qubit disjoint two-pentagram bridge, and exact seed-support identifications with $HS(L(K_{3,3}))$ and $HS(\mathrm{Petersen})$ for arbitrary $k$. In `v3.3.0`, `ContextualityTensor/GeneralTheory.lean` closes literally all remaining theorems of `papers/disjoint-mermin/contextuality-tensor.tex` directly inside Lean 4.35.0: heterogeneous endpoint reduction (`heterogeneous_endpoint_reduction`, Theorem 2 / Eq. 7), mixed square/pentagram closed-form degree (`mixed_square_pentagram_minimum`, Eq. 12), universal general-seed asymptotics (`general_seed_epsilon_tends_to_one`, Theorem 5 / Eq. 13), arbitrary-$k$ $2k$- and $3k$-qubit literal Pauli realizations (`arbitrary_k_square_pauli_realization`, `arbitrary_k_pentagram_pauli_realization`, Eq. 5), and the independent-readout noise model (`noisyScore_closed_form`, `square_noise_threshold_iff`, `pentagram_noise_threshold_iff`, `noisy_normalized_score_tends_to_zero`, Eqs. 14–16). All six new headline theorems are promoted to 6-kernel comparator Targets 19–24.
7. **Standalone heavy Track 1 certificates (compiled in parallel CI at `v3.2.0`):** The nine standalone finite-certificate modules (`FlatData`, `PhaseData`, `Saturated`, `SaturatedFive`, `SaturatedPhaseFive`, `C3Certificate`, `C3Theorem`, `C3Spectra`, `SaturatedPhaseSeven`) are now compiled and axiom-audited live in dedicated parallel GitHub Actions jobs (`lean-verify-standalone` via `VerifyStandalone.lean` and `lean-verify-phase7` via `VerifyPhaseSeven.lean`), restoring live CI-compiled evidence for $75, 480, 729344$ and four-qubit C3 cospectrality.
8. **Six-kernel coverage:** The **24 comparator targets** in `lean/comparator.json` (including `global_actual_*`, `actual_*_min_epsilon_tends_to_one`, kernel-proved false-variant refutations `target_refute_w52_bound_64` and `target_refute_c3_signA_bound_369`, and all six Track 2 `GeneralTheory` targets 19–24) and their dependency closure are accepted by 6 independent kernels (`leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `lean-default`). All other kernel-checked theorems are checked by the standard Lean kernel.
9. **Half-violation limit (`CLAIMS.md` C04, closed in `v3.2.0`):** Lean now proves **both** directions — the lower direction for $W(2N-1,2)$, $Q^-(2N-1,2)$, and $Q^+(2N-1,2)$ (`hyperbolic_violated_fraction_eventually_gt`), AND the universal upper bound $d(S)/L(S) \le 1/2$ (`exists_assignment_violated_le_half`) for every $S$ with $0 \notin S$.
10. **Human line-by-line statement fidelity audit:** `formalization.yaml` explicitly records `human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false` until an independent mathematician (or the author line-by-line) signs off on every row of `docs/statement-fidelity.md`.

## File: `docs/statement-fidelity.md`

# Statement-Fidelity Audit Table (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`)

Maps every headline Lean 4.35.0 declaration across all three tracks to its informal mathematical statement and literature anchor so an independent mathematician can check for definition drift, weakened hypotheses, or vacuity without reading proof internals.

> **Human review status:** Mechanical compilation, non-vacuity witnesses + 8 kernel-proved perturbed-bound refutations (`NonVacuity.lean`), and 6-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid` (all 24 comparator targets in `lean/comparator.json`) are automated. Rows were narrowed on 2026-11-26 to match an independent [statement audit](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md) and updated through `v3.3.0` after closing all six formal-code errata and formalizing 100% of Track 2 Eqs. 1–16 in `ContextualityTensor/GeneralTheory.lean`. **Independent human line-by-line fidelity sign-off remains OPEN** (`human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false` in `formalization.yaml`).
